name: Modal SKULPTsynth SE
description: Modal SKULPTsynth SE synthesizer: every controller of its manual's MIDI CC implementation chart, with the values it prints.

sources.title: SKULPTsynth SE User Manual v2.1

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/modal/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/modal/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC implementation chart, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The chart prints each controller's values: a range is the parameter's, bands and named values a choice (a band's first value sent), anything else 0 - 127 with the printed text in the description.

Controllers the chart gives to two rows, both laid out: CC 101: Mod Slot 1 Source, Mod Slot 1 Dest; CC 102: Mod Slot 2 Source, Mod Slot 2 Dest; CC 103: Mod Slot 3 Source, Mod Slot 3 Dest; CC 104: Mod Slot 4 Source, Mod Slot 4 Dest; CC 105: Mod Slot 5 Source, Mod Slot 5 Dest; CC 106: Mod Slot 6 Source, Mod Slot 6 Dest; CC 107: Mod Slot 7 Source, Mod Slot 7 Dest; CC 108: Mod Slot 8 Source, Mod Slot 8 Dest. CEditor sends either, and follows neither when the instrument sends it.

Left out, the wheel, the pedals, the joystick, bank select, the NRPN controllers and the channel mode messages: CC 1 Modulation Wheel, CC 11 Expression Pedal, CC 64 Sustain Pedal, CC 120 All Sound Off, CC 121 Reset All Controllers, CC 123 All Notes Off, CC 124 Omni Off, CC 125 Omni On.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow

parameters.name: Delay Time
parameters.description: Printed: No Sync: 0 - 250 milliseconds / Sync: 8 steps, Longest delay time possible divided down.

parameters.name: Osc1 Wave
parameters.description: Printed: 0 - 21 Sine / 22-42 Tri / 43-63 Saw / 64-127 PWM duty 50% - 5%.

parameters.name: Osc2 Wave
parameters.description: Printed: 0 - 21 Sine / 22-42 Tri / 43-63 Saw / 64-85 Square / 86-127 White Noise.

parameters.name: LFO1 Shape
parameters.description: Printed: 0-32 Sine to Triangle / 33-64 - Triangle to Sawtooth / 65-96 - Sawtooth to Square / 97-127 - Square to Sample and Hold.

parameters.name: LFO2 Shape
parameters.description: Printed: 0-32 Sine to Triangle / 33-64 - Triangle to Sawtooth / 65-96 - Sawtooth to Square / 97-127 - Square to Sample and Hold.

parameters.name: Arp Direction
parameters.description: Printed: 0-20 = Forwards, 21-41 = Backwards, 42-62 = Pendulum, 63 - 83 = Note Forwards, 84 - 104 = Note Backwards, 105-127 = Note Pendulum.

parameters.name: Sequence Loop
parameters.description: Printed: To Skulpt: 127 sets loop start point, 0 sets loop stop point. From Skulpt: 127 is currently looping, 0 is not looping.

parameters.name: Anim 1 CC
parameters.description: Printed: CC number of new destination.
